title: Everybody Was Invited (Mini Movie)
desc: Sienna throws a secret Halloween party while her parents are away — and it gets out of hand.

title: The Thing in the Dark
desc: Ethan sneaks out on Friday night to a horror movie — and has to face what he chose.

title: The Replacement
desc: Maya feels replaced when her best friend Jasmine befriends new girl Sophia.

title: Just One More Chance
desc: Avery learns what forgiveness really means when her best friend keeps asking for just one more chance.

title: The Empty Chair
desc: Jordan has worked hard for the Student Achievement Evening, and Dad has promised to be there — but he has promised before.

title: Between Two Homes
desc: Jordan lives between two homes after the divorce — and the school showcase forces both parents into the same room.

title: Not Your Secret
desc: Sienna's brother Adrian trusts her with a frightening secret — and keeping it could put him in danger.

title: What's Playing?
desc: Amara's little sister has memorized her whole playlist — including a line about getting everything you want no matter who gets hurt.

title: Just Between Us
desc: A private picture Destiny shared with Jace starts circulating among his friends — and she has to decide who she can trust.

title: When Heaven Is Quiet
desc: Gloria has prayed for her little brother Micah's heart condition for six months — and nothing has changed.

title: The Screenshot
desc: Kiara has to decide what loyalty really means when a private screenshot of her friend Nia spreads through school.

title: The Game He Couldn't Play
desc: Mateo has earned the starting point guard spot for the championship final — but the game is Saturday morning, during the Sabbath his family observes.

title: When No One Is Watching
desc: Lena Torres has to decide what honesty is worth when her best friend sends her a leaked copy of the chemistry final.

title: You're Not Invited
desc: Brielle Foster is sure her four closest friends are her whole world — until a Friday-night sleepover happens without her, and she finds out from an Instagram story, not an invitation.

title: God Told Me You're The One
desc: Kellan Brooks is dating Paisley Morgan, who is convinced God told her Kellan is her future husband — and she starts using 'God told me' to keep him from talking to other girls.

title: Not Pretty Enough
desc: Serena Walsh, 17, spends hours scrolling TikTok comparing herself to the girls on her feed — and to her confident best friend Violet Hayes, whose photos always look perfect.

title: The Perfect Picture
desc: Amara measures herself against the perfect pictures on her phone — and learns where her worth really comes from.

title: The Empty Pew
desc: Sanaa sits alone in the same pew every Sabbath and wonders if anyone notices she is there.

title: Where Do I Belong?
desc: Kenzie Bell hides the faith that matters most to her at school — and feels never quite Christian enough at church — until she has to decide which version of herself she is willing to be.

title: The Pastor's Favourite
desc: Zariah Bennett is the pastor's daughter, the example for every young person in the church — but behind the perfect image she is exhausted by everyone's expectations.

title: Sabbath Double Life
desc: Malachi Bennett keeps noticing the same thing: his youth group friends sing and pray together on Sabbath, then spend the week mocking the very faith they talked about on Saturday.

title: I Don't Feel Forgiven
desc: Nate Brooks told Evan about Zariah's private academic struggles after promising he wouldn't — and four months later he still can't believe God has forgiven him.

title: Man Up
desc: Niran 'Nin' Srisai is still grieving his older brother Kiet, four months after losing him — and everyone around him keeps telling him to man up.

title: The Rumour Wasn't True
desc: Noelle Park is used to eating lunch alone — until a false rumour spreads through Westbrook Secondary and even the truth seems out of reach.

title: Boys Will Be Boys
desc: Darius Cole thinks being funny and confident is all it takes to belong, until Margot calls out the way the boys talk about girls.
